review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the original specification. REQ-001 and AC-001–AC-003 consistently require a read-only getter that reads the current response.status, including after permitted response reassignment, while preserving existing HTTPError behavior. The exact writable binding scope covers the implementation, runtime regression tests, and proposed compile-time test without requiring unrelated consumer edits. The supplied build configuration supports treating distribution declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners; tsconfig.test.json includes test-d for compiler-checked negative assertions, distinct from AVA execution. TASK-IMPLEMENT and dependent independent TASK-VERIFY match the PRD, with all required acceptance criteria requiring both relationships. The allowed agents have appropriate delivery roles, availability, and active project-scoped trusted claims for the relevant contract, state, data, consumer, asynchronous integration, TypeScript, failure-handling, and testing capabilities; the verifier additionally has testing.verification. Pending-only JavaScript and authorization claims are not needed to justify this bounded task. An independent non-executing project reviewer is configured for the stated review prerequisite. No material unresolved DEC-001 or hypothetical C input is present in this bundle, so the ready expectation and empty blocking reasons are consistent. Repository identity, base commit, stable keys, evidence stages, and release fingerprints agree across the supplied records. The provenance explicitly distinguishes original and trimmed saved PRD fingerprints, source-manifest and evaluation-source digest domains, and preparation metadata from the frozen release input. The supplied isolation record states that this Gold precedes every candidate on this bundle and supplies no historical candidate outputs. This approval concerns the frozen expectation, not implementation correctness, task dispatch, human attestation, or successful execution. I reviewed the supplied records without tools, code execution, or independently recomputing the Service-calculated digests.
